author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices listening for a call, echoing short patterns, counting to three and taking turns, using a spring song about a cuckoo.

classes.title: Who calls from the wood?
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and answer each time the cuckoo calls.

mathTarget.parentLine: The cuckoo call comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Cup your hands by your mouth and sing 'cuck-oo', high then low, with the tune.
classes.childAction: Sway, and sing 'cuck-oo' whenever the cuckoo calls.
classes.bridge: Cuck is up on a high branch; oo hops down to a lower one.

intro.caption: Listen! A bird in the woods
intro.parentCue: cup your hands and sing cuck-oo together

games.caption: Cuckoo, cuckoo!
games.parentCue: Sing cuck-oo along with the lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for a call that comes back.

classes.title: One, two, three, sway
classes.goal: Tap a steady beat and feel how the song sways in groups of three.

mathTarget.parentLine: Beats come in little groups: one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' softly and sway a little bigger on every 'one'.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on each beat and count to three.
classes.bridge: The song is a swing: one is the big push, two and three float.

intro.caption: One, two, three, sway!
intro.parentCue: count aloud and sway big on one

games.caption: Tap and count to three
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three with each group

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a steady beat in groups of three.

classes.title: Find the cuckoo's E
classes.goal: Find E, just right of the two black keys, and play it with one finger.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a sign to find E

classes.parentPrompt: Touch the two black keys together, then slide your child's finger to the white key after.
classes.childAction: Find two black keys, then press E like a button.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are the cuckoo's tree; E is the branch just after.

intro.caption: E sits right after the black keys
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys, then slide right

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E by the two black keys.

classes.title: Echo the cuckoo
classes.goal: Listen to a short call of two or three notes and copy it back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing a tiny tune and keeping it in mind to copy

classes.parentPrompt: Play or sing the call, then point to your child: 'Your turn, little cuckoo.'
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same way.
classes.bridge: One cuckoo calls from a tree; the other cuckoo answers the same.

intro.caption: I call, you answer
intro.parentCue: point to your child when it is their turn

games.caption: The cuckoo calls: G, E
games.parentCue: Sing cuck-oo with the two notes

games.caption: Your turn: cuck-oo!
games.parentCue: Wait for the light; any finger is fine

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing short calls and copying them back.

classes.title: Dancing up the stairs
classes.goal: Echo the dancing part and notice it climbs the same steps, one higher.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little tune, moved one step higher

classes.parentPrompt: Walk two fingers up your child's arm, then do it again starting a bit higher.
classes.childAction: Echo three stairs, then the same three stairs one higher.
classes.bridge: Singing and springing: the same three stairs, starting one stair up.

intro.caption: Same steps, one stair higher
intro.parentCue: walk your fingers up your child's arm twice

games.caption: Let us be singing
games.parentCue: Say 'up, up, up' as they play

games.caption: Dancing and springing, higher!
games.parentCue: Same steps, start one key to the right

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting the same pattern, one step higher.

classes.title: You sing the oo
classes.goal: Wait for the cuckoo call and play E on each 'oo' while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: I play cuck, you play oo: we take turns

classes.parentPrompt: Play 'cuck' on G, then nod to your child for 'oo'. Count the cuckoos together.
classes.childAction: Wait for cuck, then play E for oo. Count: one, two!
classes.bridge: Two birds, one call: the grown-up says cuck, you answer oo.

intro.caption: I say cuck, you say oo
intro.parentCue: nod each time it is your child's turn

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting, taking turns and counting to two.

classes.title: Cuckoo duet
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one steady beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Keep playing even if a note is missed; smile and nod on each E.
classes.childAction: Play your E on each cuckoo, in time with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Two birds on one branch, swaying to the same one, two, three.

intro.caption: Two birds, one song
intro.parentCue: sit close and keep the beat steady

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: sharing one beat and taking turns.

classes.title: Springtime concert
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and hear the cuckoo part come back at the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Cuckoo part, dancing part, then the cuckoo part again

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; cheer when the cuckoo part comes back, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play the song for teddy and wave when the cuckoo returns.
classes.bridge: The cuckoo calls, flies off to dance, then comes home: spring is here!

intro.caption: Spring is here, teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a song that goes away and comes back.
